pat: ACME deal follow-up: they need guidance on reserved GPUs vs burst for expected spikes ~700 rps for 10-20m; baseline ~300 rps.

nina: key inputs? avg tokens? latency SLOs? model choice?

pat: avg 200 tokens, p95 < 900ms, prefer 13B quant.

carlos: rough calc: baseline reserved for 300 rps, reserve 5 GPUs, add burst pool to cover +400 rps. autoscale: min 3 / max 12, fast ramp 30s.

ops-bot: autoscale template: {"min":3,"max":12,"metric":"rps","target_per_replica":80} 

sec-bot: ACME requires customer KMS + audit logs. we support KMS on Dedicated/Private; hosted has envelope + logs export.

nina: recommend KV preheat 10m before promo, edge rate limit (HTTP 429) and cached fallback for heavy queries. include 12mo reserved quote from finance.

pat: will draft proposal: reserved 5 GPUs + burst credits, autoscale min3/max12, KV preheat, security appendix. scheduling POC preflight tomorrow.

carlos: I'll prepare runbook and perf appendix (latency vs cost for quant13 vs fp16 70B).
